sam: Noticed regressions on host-side for very small requests after last kernel selection + batching tweak. p99 up ~15% on seq <= 24.

sam: Quick flame shows hot path: preparse.Canonicalize -> tokenizer.FastTokenize -> kvcache.Lookup -> grpc.emitSmallFrame -> net.writev.

priya: pprof dump from canary:
```
pprof top
28.7% preparse.Canonicalize
24.2% tokenizer.FastTokenize
13.5% kvcache.Lookup
10.1% grpc.emitSmallFrame
8.3% net.writev
```

yang: Canonicalize change added header ordering + a defensive copy to avoid aliasing. That copy is small but done for every request and allocs/growslice show up in profile.

mara: repro: `./tools/repro/smolreq --qps 600 --seq 16 --clients 150` + grab profile from :6060.

sam: Short-term mitigation: 1) gate canonicalize copy for requests < 64 bytes 2) enable proxy writev coalesce 3) reduce batching.window for small-req route.

priya: I implemented a no-copy path behind flag and ran a single canary: p99 dropped ~11% and allocs down 40%. Pushing a draft PR.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-2102 assigned to eng-runtime, priority P2.

yang: Plan: land no-copy path behind flag, run 3 canaries with writev_coalesce=true and batching.window=4ms. If stable, roll to staging and then prod.

mara: also add canonicalization unit tests to ensure deterministic prefixing so kvcache hitrate doesn't regress.

sam: thanks. scheduling postmortem + perf graphs after canary run.
